title: Host's father dreamed of an earthquake on January 17th before the Northridge quake

tellings.quote: in it he talks about how he would always dream of an earthquake on Jan January 17th

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says his father wrote about a recurring dream in a book called The Tools, around the early 1990s in Los Angeles. According to Michels, his father would always dream of an earthquake on January 17th, and Michels ties this to the Northridge earthquake that later struck Los Angeles. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest dreams can show events before they happen.
